text:
Rina: FYI getting reports that enablement feedback is triggering duplicate onboarding nudges for a subset of customers this morning. saw ~150 dupes in the last 2h.
Joel: saw that in the webhook-debug stream too. payloads look identical but delivered twice. can you paste an example?
Maya: example payload from the partner webhook (redacted):
```
{
  "feedback_id": null,
  "account_id": 800912,
  "user_email": "redacted@example.com",
  "submitted_at": "2026-03-10T14:22:11Z",
  "responses": {...},
  "metadata": {"source": "partner-x"}
}
```
Rina: note feedback_id is null for these, partner recently removed our client-generated id in favor of an internal uuid but didn't include it in the payload.
ops-bot: :information_source: webhook-delivery-service: 2026-03-10T14:22:12Z sent event id 987654321, retry=0
ops-bot: :information_source: webhook-delivery-service: 2026-03-10T14:22:12Z sent event id 987654322, retry=0
Joel: two delivery events within the same second with different event ids -> looks like the partner sent the same body twice with different transport ids. our playbook dedupe key is feedback_id so null causes us to process both.
Maya: SQL to find affected accounts:
```
SELECT account_id, count(*) as num_feedbacks, min(submitted_at) as first_seen
FROM enablement.feedback_events
WHERE submitted_at > '2026-03-10 12:00:00' AND (feedback_id IS NULL OR feedback_id = '')
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
Joel: results: ~152 accounts, most got 2 events, a few got 3. nudges fired each time because playbook checks only recent_feedback_count > 0.
Rina: mitigation proposal: 1) quickly add a temporary dedupe by (account_id, date_floor(submitted_at, 'minute'), metadata->>'source') in the playbook rule so immediate duplicates within a minute are ignored; 2) ask partner to include an idempotency feedback_id or include a hashed payload_id; 3) backfill and retract duplicate nudges for high-value accounts.
Maya: I'll push the minute-window dedupe change with high priority and flag it in the runbook.
Joel: also add a telemetry alert: >2x feedback events per-account within 5m for any cohort.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Playbook update scheduled by Maya at 14:45 UTC, change id pb-20260310-42.
Rina: follow-up: create a small bulk-notice to CS for the affected accounts so they don't double-reach customers; include a list of ~150 accounts.
CS-Eng: noted. I'll add a permanent change to treat empty feedback_id as invalid and use a deterministic hash of account+submitted_at+source as fallback id, and I'll file an integration ticket for partner-x to add a proper idempotency key.
Rina: thanks all. once the hotfix is live let's monitor enablement.nudge_rate and customer complaint queue for 2h. :thumbsup:
